proposal.reason: Main change is in enqueue/runtime launch plumbing: kernel plans now pass explicit argument-buffer pointer and byte size to hgLaunchKernelExAD, and the global kernel-arg budget/storage is raised to 4 KiB. Symmetric is additionally required because symmetric multi-task planning now computes and allocates variable-sized argument payloads from scoped memory (removing the fixed 4 KiB pool path). Kernels is additionally required due to device-kernel launch ABI/signature updates from 1 KiB to 4 KiB argument structs, a substantive interface change even with small diffs.
